import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

def run(config_path):
    config = json.loads(Path(config_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    renderer = Path(config["renderer"])
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(renderer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(renderer), "exec"), namespace)
    with Path(config["input"]).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        orders = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
    total = sum(int(order["value"]) for order in orders)
    text = namespace["render"](len(orders), total)
    Path(config["output"]).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(text, end="")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run(sys.argv[1])
